title: [Ops] Continuity pack: second key-holder, runbook-only deploy/rollback drill, security tabletop and a second alert channel
done_when: Named second key-holder holds tested access (GitHub org, AWS management, registrar, break-glass); 'run without the agent' page; one runbook-only deploy+rollback and one security tabletop (break-glass test + CRM key rotation) in the drill index; alarms reach a second channel.

title: [Security] Pre-pilot identity hardening: workforce admin MFA, access review, account guards, ZAP baseline
done_when: Workforce admins cannot sign in without TOTP (or Google IdP + 2SV), ADR 0006 amended; Q4 access review recorded; allowed_account_ids on aa365 and acc3; read-only default agent role decided; one ZAP baseline triaged; fork-PR approval = all external contributors.

title: [Data] Retention go-live and tenant-isolation debt: approve proposed DM-7.1 rows, first live runs, RLS allowlist cleanup
done_when: 69 proposed DM-7.1 rows approved by group; CIS, Booking, CRM retention each finish one live run with archive (doc says JSONL.gz, not Parquet); new-table rule in CI; RLS allowlist has no stale entries and every tenant_id table has RLS or a written exception.

title: [AI Gateway] PII scrub before every free-text AI call and one hard cap for every caller (CIS, TripPlanner, CRM)
done_when: F3 scrub in the shared gateway for free_text stages, fail closed; ADR 0009 d10 accepted; CRM AI calls via gateway ledger and connection caps; over-cap flag in catalog.v_llm_gateway_config_v1; acc3 budget catches Marketplace spend or matches gateway cap.

title: [TripPlanner] Custom-domain follow-up: entitlement check, subject_gate tenant allow-list, ReDoS fix, CodeQL on AA-Partner
done_when: add_domain refuses tenants without tp.custom_domain; links to a verified tenant domain pass subject_gate; CodeQL #60/#62 closed; Partner CodeQL default setup on; tests cover all three.

title: [TripPlanner] Ship the launcher snippet and agency-only branding (no Adventure Asia strings, locale, B2C leftovers removed)
done_when: Basic-plan tenant copies a launcher snippet opening /{slug}/plan (no iframe, CSP unchanged); agency name in title/description/og:site_name with test guard; html lang follows tenant locale; /sign-in and /trips 404; tp.ai_sessions enforced; compose-body guard test.

title: [Add-ons] End-to-end add-on lifecycle: New tenant runs the provisioning saga, CRM agency auto-created, TripPlanner module in the agency app
done_when: New tenant calls the saga (theme, lead channel, TP domain, CRM agency + owner invite) with no hand steps; agency app TripPlanner module (site link, lead channel, theme, locale, leads, usage); remaining CRM gates enforced; seat-overage invoice line; TP webhook/e-mail leads proven live on a synthetic tenant; trial on attach per decision.
needs: tech lead (trial on attach) + business owner (prices G1)

title: [Go-live] One dated go-live gate: checklist with CI guard and the proofs it needs (price coverage, Booking restore drill, load test, edge rate limits)
done_when: ~15-line checklist in repo with CI guard linking proofs: price/photo coverage per pilot market, Booking per-partner restore drill, bounded CIS/TP load test (no LLM), edge rate-limit decision, prod capacity base, enforce_admins plan, 'no real PII before DPA signed'; go-live date set.

title: [Docs] Bring runbooks, architecture pages and the feature catalogue back to reality, with drift lints
done_when: Every runbook has last_tested or marked untested; stale-phrase lint; alarms.md masks ALB/TG IDs; free-tier limits table in finops.md; features.yaml planned rows + proven field; plan_sync.py fails CI on drift; CIS CONTEXT.md split; postmortem template has detected_at/resolved_at.

title: [DevOps] Release safety: TripPlanner merge queue and strict checks, smoke-red rollback, release-please, CRM Sentry, DB Migrate input check
done_when: TP main strict checks + merge queue + coverage floor; red post-deploy smoke rolls back or opens an issue for every web app; release-please merged weekly or removed; CRM api sends a test event to its Sentry project; DB Migrate validates input before dispatch.
